question: Customers are reporting checkout failures on demo-shop. Find the most likely root cause, with evidence.
root_cause: The new revision set PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS=150, below the payment provider's normal 80-400 ms response time, so most checkouts time out and return 502. Heavy healthy /products traffic pushes the change out of the most recent log lines.
key_evidence: Config change creating the bad revision with PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS=150
'Payment provider request timed out' errors with timeout_ms=150, only on the bad revision
